title: Kobayashi-san Chi no Maid Dragon Movie: Samishigariya no Ryuu

alternative_titles.en: Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid: A Lonely Dragon Wants to be Loved
alternative_titles.ja: 映画 小林さんちのメイドラゴン さみしがりやの竜

synopsis:
While Kanna Kamui lives comfortably under the same roof as Kobayashi and Tooru, she starts to long for her father Kimun's affection after seeing him in a dream. Coincidentally, Kimun soon arrives on Earth and explains that he needs Kanna to return home as she is crucial to winning a war in the dragons' world.

However, as Kanna's guardian, Kobayashi hesitates to cooperate with Kimun, knowing that he has neglected Kanna for many years. Although the two eventually reach a compromise that allows Kanna to stay on Earth, Kobayashi has little hope of Kimun changing his barbaric ways. Regardless, she still wants to help Kanna and Kimun overcome their distance.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
